topic: Warning that private location worker is outdated
environment: Private location with one or more workers in Docker
symptom_pattern: The private location page warns that at least one worker isn't on the latest image; customer worries they need a new private location and new keys.
root_cause: One worker is running an older image version. Upgrading only requires running the new image with the same config file; keys don't change.
resolution_path: Find the outdated worker in the private location side panel
Start a new worker on the latest stable tag with the same config
Remove the old worker once the new one reports
info_needed: worker versions in the side panel
whether multiple PLs share a name

qa_pairs.tse_question: How many workers report to this private location?
Do you still have the original config JSON?
